name: vid.judge/hallucination/videohallucer
source: VideoHallucer, object-relation and temporal subsets (Wang et al., 2024)
notes: 250 videos, each with VideoHallucer's basic and hallucinated question (250 yes, 250 no); the two items of a video share meta['group'].

name: vid.judge/t2v/videofeedback
source: VideoFeedback, text-to-video alignment, test split (He et al., 2024)
criteria_source: Adapted from VideoFeedback's four-level text-to-video alignment scale
notes: 500 generated videos with their generation prompt quoted verbatim; gold is the annotated alignment level. The ratings are VideoFeedback's human labels on its test split and the items a seeded random draw, so they keep the dataset's distribution: 24 / 33 / 43 / 0.6 % rated 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 (the test split holds only 15 'Perfect' ratings).
